performance.verdict: Leads are real but 5 overdue SOW milestones mean attribution and launch are still broken.

findings.text: 5 SOW milestones overdue since July 31–Aug 1: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site/Landing Pages, Ads Launch, Meta Retargeting — all unconfirmed completed.
CPL dropped -89.48% 7d vs prior 7d to $234.30 over 28 days, driven by 10 leads vs near-zero prior; baseline too thin to call efficiency confirmed.
3-day lead signal (Sep 8–10: 2,1,2 = 5 leads) vs prior 3 days (Sep 5–7: 1,1,1 = 3 leads) is modestly improving, but Google spend on Sep 9 was $268 with no confirmed conversions.
GBP actions collapsed -77.14% 7d vs prior 7d; last 3 series days (Sep 8–10) show 0,0,0 GBP actions — organic referral to ads is dark for 3 consecutive days.
GHL shows 137 contacts and 55 opportunities created but 0 won, 0 appointments, and opportunity value of $0 — leads are entering but no intake conversion is tracked.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 5 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer immediately; LSA and pixel gaps are corrupting attribution on a $2,343 28-day spend.
suggestions.monday_update: Five SOW milestones due July 31–August 1 show no completed event: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site/Landing Pages, Ads Launch, and Meta Retargeting Launch. These block clean attribution on $2,342.96 in spend and prevent confirming whether the 10 leads are properly source-tagged. Nacer to confirm completion status or re-assign owners by 2026-09-14. Success check: all five items marked complete with documented evidence in Monday by September 14.

suggestions.text: Investigate GHL pipeline: 55 opportunities created, 0 appointments booked — confirm intake routing and speed-to-lead are functioning within the 5-minute SLA.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 55 opportunities created and 137 contacts over 28 days but zero appointments and zero won deals, indicating a broken or unmanned intake step after lead capture. This is an intake routing problem, not an ads problem. Sohib to audit the GHL booking calendar, assignment rules, and after-hours auto-reply to confirm the 5-minute speed-to-lead SLA is active. Success check: at least 1 confirmed booked appointment visible in GHL by the next check on 2026-09-14.
